Made with the mirtverse instructor toolkit ({{made_with}}).

* The data live in the data/ folder next to this file. Replace them with
  mirtverse::swap_lab_data() rather than by hand; the text and the answer
  checks are computed from whatever data are there.
* Each section starts with an "mv-section" comment. add_lab_section(),
  add_lab_exercise(), add_lab_question() and remove_lab_section() use these
  markers, so keep them when you edit a section by hand.
* Run mirtverse::check_material() on this folder after every edit.

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(mirtverse)
tutorial_options(exercise.checker = mirtverse::lab_checker,
                 exercise.timelimit = 120, exercise.lines = 6)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)
lab <- mirtverse::lab_data()
resp <- lab$responses
group <- lab$group
models <- lab$models
```

```{r setup-fit, include = FALSE}
fit <- mirt(resp, 1, itemtype = models[2], verbose = FALSE)
```
